title: Neptu blog category registry (_categories.yaml)
description: Array of category definitions for one locale. Posts reference a category by `id` in the `category` / `categories` frontmatter fields. Extra fields are preserved and reach components through `frontmatter.categories[]`.

id.description: Stable, language-independent key. Referenced from post frontmatter, used to merge entries across config layers, and used by the language switcher to map a category page from one locale to another — so keep it identical in every locale.

name.description: Display name in this locale. Defaults to `id`.

slug.description: URL segment in this locale (`/<locale>/categories/<slug>/1`). Defaults to `id`; set it only when you want a locale-specific URL.

description.description: Free-form note about the category. Not rendered by the built-in components; available to your own via `frontmatter.categories[]`.
